description: ADR-0009 + ADR-0013: the apps/<name>/ entries of protected_prefixes are the kit-app list (Roxabi/roxabi-boilerplate-cf#318) — every other app is a product app, and zero-edit refuses any other apps/ entry shape; kit paths under {config,scripts,docs}/kit; product under */product; root and .github/workflows kit surfaces stay on the explicit protected_files list per ADR-0013; workflows are classified by the product- filename prefix or by being listed; under {config,scripts,docs} only tool_mandated_paths (exact paths an external tool fixes, each also in protected_files) are classified outside */kit and */product (ADR-0009 D1 amendment, Roxabi/roxabi-boilerplate-cf#259); bun.lock is intentionally not protected (product workspace co-ownership — see Roxabi/roxabi-boilerplate-cf#114); .dev/stack.yml is product-owned after inheritance (Roxabi/roxabi-boilerplate-cf#260) and is not on protected_files.

design_overrides.description: Accepted zero-edit customization of the design system. Do these first; never patch packages/ui for brand tokens.

patterns.how: Keep @import "@kit/ui/styles.css" then redeclare CSS variables on :root / .dark (primary, radius, fonts, sidebar, charts). Tokens are the kit extension surface.
Import primitives from @kit/ui and compose product shells (LoadingButton, BrandHeader). Do not copy/fork files from packages/ui/src/components.
Point @source at packages/ui and the product app only. App-level utilities stay in the product CSS tree.
Favicon, OG, logo live in the product app — not packages/ui.
